identity.mission: Create a vibrant, trustworthy, and modern rental property management system that breaks the boring 'corporate real estate' mold.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix architectural precision with lifestyle warmth.
Emotion First: Every screen should feel like a 'Welcome Home' moment.
Content is King: High-quality property imagery takes center stage.
Zoom In: Use bold close-ups of textures and details.
Negative Space: Luxurious spacing to create a premium feel.

headings.usage: All headings (h1-h6), hero text, and major stats.

body.usage: Paragraphs, labels, inputs, and table data.

mono.usage: IDs, API keys, and technical data in admin dashboard.

colors.mode: Light Mode First (with Dark Mode support)
rules: Do not use generic full-screen gradients.
Use 'Electric Indigo' (#4F46E5) for primary actions (Book Visit, Login).
Use 'Lime Green' (#84CC16) for positive states (Available, Income Up).
Backgrounds should be stark white or very subtle off-white (#F8FAFC) to let images pop.

glassmorphism.usage: Sticky headers, floating action bars, and modal overlays.

borders.usage: Subtle 1px borders on cards and inputs.

marketing_listings.card_style: Clean, image-first cards with minimal text overlay.

dashboard.widgets: Dense, data-rich cards with clear hierarchy.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-11 px-8 rounded-full font-medium transition-all hover:scale-[1.02]
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 h-11 px-8 rounded-full font-medium

cards.dashboard: rounded-xl border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm p-6

property_interiors.description: Bright modern living room with large window

universal_guidelines: All interactive elements MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute.
Do not use gradients on text; it reduces readability.
Ensure all images have 'alt' tags for accessibility.
Do not use 'Inter' font for headings; use 'Outfit'.
Maintain 2-3x more spacing than typical designs (e.g., p-8 instead of p-4).
Use 'framer-motion' for smooth transitions between states.
Never use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or overlays without a blur/scrim.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a Rental Property Management System. Use the provided colors, typography, and image URLs to create a high-end, trustworthy, and vibrant platform. Focus on the 'Tenant' experience for the landing/listing pages (make it visual) and the 'Owner/Admin' experience for dashboards (make it data-dense but clean). Implement the 'Visit Request' workflow with a clear step-by-step UI.
